recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic, high-contrast composition featuring a male figure in a mid-dance pose against a weathered, industrial concrete wall. The scene is characterized by a cool teal and dark blue color palette punctuated by vibrant horizontal lens flares and glowing, futuristic typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's kinetic pose creates a diagonal tension against the vertical wall texture.
Horizontal light streaks bisect the composition, grounding the floating typography.
The contrast between the gritty, desaturated background and the clean, glowing neon text.
coreInvariants: Horizontal blue and orange lens flares
Geometric sans-serif typography with outer glows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, full body, slightly off-center to the left, scaled to occupy 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing artist name in the lower-right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's head, follows the arm extension to the right, drops to the glowing text, and follows the leg back to the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, heavy shadows at the bottom and top-left corners provide breathing room for the central action.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal and charcoal grey (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated beige and white (subject's clothing and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric blue and amber (lens flares and text glows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment contrasted with high-value, high-saturation light effects.

letterConstructionRules: Extended horizontal bars that merge into lens flare lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' and 'D' feature rounded, open curves

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated via glow and horizontal light beams
Anchored by a thin orange horizontal line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a large, airy geometric display face and a small, wide, blocky secondary face.
graphicDevices: Cyan and magenta chromatic aberration on edges
Soft blue outer glow on primary text

preserve: Wide tracking of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and clean lines of the primary display text.
Matches the wide, square, industrial feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty urban scene with a male dancer in a dynamic pose against a textured concrete wall. Use cool teal lighting with heavy shadows at the bottom. Add a horizontal blue lens flare across the middle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large geometric sans-serif name in the bottom right with a cyan outer glow. Add a secondary wide-tracked title across the center-left on a thin orange horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text glowing blue?
Is the secondary text widely spaced and orange?
Does the horizontal flare pass through the text?
Is the background texture visible through the shadows?

mustRedesign: Any recognizable brand logos on clothing

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject's face and hands
Seamless integration of light effects and text

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the glowing text.
Ensure the subject's pose feels balanced and athletic.
Verify the color temperature is consistently cool with warm accents.
Confirm the horizontal lines are perfectly level.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-action urban portrait with geometric neon typography and horizontal light-leak motifs to create a modern pop/R&B aesthetic.
